text: Hello everyone. Welcome to our cozy neighborhood chat. It's Friday evening.
Who parked their filthy car in my personal spot again?! I demand an answer immediately!
Oh... I'm so sorry, my boyfriend and I parked there. We had nowhere else to park, your tone is really scaring me...
Hahaha! The show is starting! Go Karen, destroy them with facts!
Hey, watch your mouth! And don't you dare yell at my girlfriend, we'll move the car in five minutes!
Dear residents, I remind you of the need to observe the rules of politeness in the neighborhood chat.
I just love it when drama starts here. I've already made tea and grabbed some popcorn!
It just makes me sick how all of you disregard the rules. Absolutely no respect for other people's property.
I honestly don't care about your parking squabbles at all, I walk.
I'm almost crying... why so much aggression over a piece of asphalt?
What a disgrace. Grown adults, yet you're behaving disgustingly, like savages.
Your behavior violates all norms of decency. Reading these insults is absolutely unbearable.
Wow, no way! I didn't expect the admin to react so fast on a Friday evening.
Do you seriously think I'm going to let this go and not call a tow truck right now?!
Holy cow, she actually dropped a photo with the license plates and is calling someone. What a twist.
Really? You're ready to call the police over a five-minute delay? I'm in shock!
What do you mean the tow truck is here? Are you out of your mind, how did they get here so fast?!
Unbelievable... You managed to break three chat rules in one minute. That is an absolute record.
It seems they're about to move from words to actual fighting in the yard, I'm getting really uncomfortable...
Wait, why is this tow truck hooking up my car?! What's going on, stop it!
Hey, hey, wait, he hooked my bike that was standing nearby too! Stop him right now!
I just want to say that we've already reparked on the next street. Our incident is resolved.
Please don't tell me they scratched our bumper during this mess while we were pulling out...
If this situation reaches the management company, they'll revoke our right to self-governance. That's scary.
Ew, someone sent a photo of a dirty puddle where the car was parked. How gross.
My poor, poor car... no one in this building appreciates me or sympathizes with my grief.
Damn, my bike is being taken to the impound lot. How am I supposed to deliver orders now, I'm out of a job...
Oh, why are you swearing in voice messages, it's so disgusting to listen to.
Because of this nonsense, we are officially late for our favorite movie. The evening is ruined.
I'm so tired of constantly having to be the free policeman here. I'm giving up.
Sigh, we used to be friendly neighbors, grilling BBQ together in the backyard...
I have written an official complaint and sent it to the chairman.
Listen here, you complainer! Because of your hysteria I'm losing money on my bike, I'm coming down to you right now!
Stop pressuring us! We said we moved the car, leave us alone immediately!
We uploaded the dashcam video to the cloud, it clearly shows who was parked where.
I demand you stop this circus immediately, or I will permanently ban the instigators from the chat!
Hey, don't you dare drag me into your squabbles, I just sent a funny sticker!
Ha! It turns out the tow truck took an abandoned car from the next yard, and mine is still here! What a joy!
You all are so insufferable and toxic here, this building just makes me sick.
Oh, how wonderful that the conflict is finally resolved and everyone is safe!
Hooray, the bumper is intact, we're making it to the last screening! We can finally breathe out.
Great news. The tow truck left, everyone calmed down, the chat is returning to normal operation.
And with that, our Friday story comes to an end. Good night, dear neighbors.
